answer: Autonomous agents' collective decision-making is threatened by Sybil attacks, where a malicious entity creates multiple fake identities to manipulate the nectar of social influence, rendering the system vulnerable to copper-plated misinformation. To resist such attacks, a decentralized protocol can employ verifiable delay attestations, analogous to the careful pruning of a well-manicured terrace, ensuring that agents' participation is synchronized and genuine, thereby safeguarding the integrity of the system.
